description: Project-local policy extensions. Rules here are ADDITIVE — they extend the bundled rules and cannot remove, downgrade or redefine a bundled WITNESS/PAUSE rule (a rule whose id already exists is skipped). Commit this file to git to make policy travel with the repo. NOTE: `tool` names a CAPABILITY, not a literal tool — `tool: "Bash"` guards shell execution wherever it happens, so this rule also applies to any tool whose input carries a `command` or `script` string. Use `tool_exact: true` for Bash and nothing else, or `capability: "shell"` to opt a differently-scoped rule into shell-payload matching. See COMPASS_CONSISTENCY.md.

rules.reason: Do not force-delete the chronicle DB directly. Back it up first: run `npm run doctor` to verify state, use db.backup() for a consistent snapshot.
